title: Common Craft System como Conversor Universal de Abates Idle
sourceConcept: Common Craft Universal Kill Charge Gauge
currentState: CraftService has 13 manual recipes; idle kills do not generate self-crafting energy
observedGap: Lack of autonomous converter turning long grinding sessions into utility scrolls and consumables
designPrinciple: Continuous combat should passively fuel an auxiliary utility gauge rewarding active play with utility autonomy.
possibleAdaptation: Add Common Craft charge meter to hunting UI filling every mob kill; at 100%, allows crafting D/C Enchant Scrolls and potions.
conflicts: None. Aligns perfectly with idle game self-sufficiency.
season1Impact: Critical. Provides casual and F2P players a reliable source of enchant scrolls.
contentGaps: Point gain formula per monster level tier.

title: Consumo Diferenciado de Tiros por Arma e Multiplicadores AoE
currentState: Uniform 1 shot consumed per attack/spell regardless of weapon type or targets hit
observedGap: Ranged and AoE classes clear screens without proportional operational resource costs
designPrinciple: Operational cost must scale with projection power, attack range, and multi-target coverage.
possibleAdaptation: Melee: 1 shot; Bows: 2-3 shots; AoE: x1 (1-3 targets), x2 (4-8 targets), x3 (9-16 targets).
conflicts: Requires adjusting Adena drop rates in mid zones so archers don't run dry too quickly.
season1Impact: High. Balances melee risk vs ranged safety.
contentGaps: None. Fully documented in L2Wiki table.

title: Fechamento da Cadeia Econômica de Refino para Equipamentos D/C
currentState: Refinery creates 12 materials, but CRAFTING_RECIPES has only 13 items; mobs drop complete gear
observedGap: Refined materials (Steel, Crafted Leather, Cord, Braided Hemp) have no recipe sinks, becoming orphan goods
designPrinciple: Every refined material must have at least three viable equipment recipe sinks.
possibleAdaptation: Expand CRAFTING_RECIPES for Brigandine, Manticore, Mithril, Full Plate, Plated Leather, Bastard Sword, and Elven Bow.
conflicts: None. Enriches gameplay without altering power limits.
season1Impact: Critical. Connects gathering, mining, and hunting directly to character power.
contentGaps: Formalize exact ingredient quantities for Season 1 recipes.

title: Sistema de Coleções (Collections) como Ralo Eterno de Equipamento
sourceConcept: Collections Metagame & Permanent Item Sacrificial Sink
currentState: Surplus and obsolete gear is sold in bulk for negligible Adena via sellAllJunk
observedGap: Absence of a permanent metagame sink consuming low-grade surplus gear from idle farming
designPrinciple: Permanent sacrifice of surplus items for minor, cumulative account-wide stats stabilizes market values.
possibleAdaptation: Create Season 1 Collections (Talking Island, Gludio, Dion) where registered gear is destroyed for +HP, +P.Def, +P.Atk.
conflicts: Must strictly adhere to CP power budget contracts (Codex CP <= 5% total CP).
season1Impact: High. Gives players a reason to farm and preserve diverse gear.

title: Checkpoints de Segurança na Síntese de Soul Crystals
currentState: Special Abilities upgrade without deterministic 5-level safety checkpoints
observedGap: High risk of total regression demotivates players from attempting high crystal upgrades
designPrinciple: Probabilistic upgrade systems require safety milestones to prevent catastrophic progress loss.
possibleAdaptation: Implement checkpoints: Lv 1-5 fails to 1; Lv 6-10 fails to 6; Lv 11-15 fails to 11.
season1Impact: Medium. Enhances satisfaction upon reaching Lv 5 crystal at Lv 40.
contentGaps: None. Fully verified in L2Wiki table.

title: Pity System com Acúmulo de Falhas na Síntese de Dolls
sourceConcept: Guaranteed Compounding Pity Gauge for Dolls
currentState: Doll synthesis uses fixed chance without cumulative bad-luck protection
observedGap: Severe bad luck streaks frustrate players who fail multiple consecutive syntheses
designPrinciple: Every failure should contribute measurable progress toward a 100% guaranteed success.
possibleAdaptation: Each failed synthesis adds +10 pity points; 100 points grants 100% success on next attempt.
season1Impact: Medium. Protects players farming Monster Dolls.

title: Bônus Escalonados de Armaduras (3 Peças Parcial / 5 Peças Completo)
currentState: Sets require all pieces equipped to unlock any set bonus
observedGap: Players get 0 benefits while holding 3 or 4 pieces of an armor set
designPrinciple: Reward incremental gear progression through intermediate synergy tiers.
possibleAdaptation: Configure 3-piece partial bonus (+5% Max HP, +3 P.Def) and 5-piece full bonus in rarity_sets.js.
season1Impact: High. Smooths transition between gear grades.
contentGaps: Configure values for 8 core Season 1 sets.

title: Afinidade de Armas em Guardiões e Mascotes de Combate
currentState: Pets give static buffs without regard to hero's weapon archetype
observedGap: Lack of tactical synergy between hero weapon choice and pet specialization
designPrinciple: Symbiotic links between hero gear and companion enhance tactical depth.
possibleAdaptation: Link pets to weapon types: Wolf buffs Daggers/Spears, Hawk buffs Bows, Buffalo buffs Heavy 2H, Kookaburra buffs Staves.
conflicts: Requires careful balance against CP caps.
contentGaps: Audit current pet roster in PetService.js.

title: Magic Lamp como Jackpots Ocasionais de EXP/SP durante o Grind
currentState: Documented in balance file but lacks active celebratory presentation during idle combat
observedGap: Grind feels overly flat without occasional celebratory dopamine spikes
designPrinciple: Controlled stochastic rewards break gameplay monotony without undermining the mathematical curve.
possibleAdaptation: Grant 1 Magic Lamp every 1,000 kills; opening yields Green (65%), Blue (30%), Purple (4%), or Red (1%) jackpot.
conflicts: Must strictly respect monotonicity in MASTER_PROGRESSION_CONTRACT.

title: Alinhamento Fiscal e Teto de 10 Lotes no Mercado P2P
sourceConcept: World Trade Rules (10 Lots, 14-Day Expiry, 5% Tax)
currentState: Has 5% tax and cloud sync, but lacks formal 10-lot cap and 14-day expiry enforcement
observedGap: Risk of database clutter and market saturation by inactive listings
designPrinciple: Artificial listing scarcity forces realistic pricing and regular inventory turnover.
possibleAdaptation: Cap listings at 10 per account, set 14-day lifespan, charge 5% upfront Adena listing fee.

title: Pergaminhos de Bênção (Item Blessing) como Aprimoramento Seguro
currentState: Gear enhancement focuses on breakable scrolls; no non-destructive prestige layer exists
observedGap: Players at safe enchant (+3/+4) hesitate to risk destroying their pinnacle gear
designPrinciple: Provide a horizontal, safe investment vector for cautious players at gear safe caps.
possibleAdaptation: Allow Scroll of Blessing on C-Grade gear to grant Blessed status (+2 CP, +5% shot efficiency) with 0 break risk.
conflicts: Must be calibrated so it doesn't inflate CP.
season1Impact: Medium. Great endgame goal for Lv 40.
contentGaps: Determine source of scrolls (Queen Ant raid or Common Craft).

title: Integração do Manor com Sementes e Troca de Refinados
currentState: ManorService exists as embryonic state, but crops do not feed refinery or alchemy
observedGap: Manor is isolated from the main game economy
designPrinciple: Agricultural systems should feed into consumable and refinery supply chains.
possibleAdaptation: Connect harvested crops (Gludio Frost Wheat) to high-tier Haste Potions and Varnish of Purity.
conflicts: Adds management complexity for idle players.
season1Impact: Low for S1; primarily an S2 castle feature.
contentGaps: Seed and reward catalogs for Dion and Giran.
